title: Home
text:
Welcome to my portfolio for MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics at the University of Pennsylvania.
This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program — weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to urban policy questions.



I’m an MCP student at Penn with a background in urban planning, GIS, and mobility research. I’m interested in urban analytics, transportation planning, and AI applications.

Assignments — analyses completed for the course

title: Week 1: Getting Set Up
text:
This week, I set up the basic workflow for my course portfolio. I created a repository from the course template, cloned it to my computer with GitHub Desktop, opened the project in RStudio, edited a Quarto file, and rendered it as a webpage. I then committed and pushed the changes to GitHub so that they could appear on my GitHub Pages site.
I also learned that a website can be understood as a collection of HTML files stored on a computer or server. Quarto helps create those HTML files: I write content in a .qmd file, and Quarto renders it into an .html file that a web browser can display.

Reflection

What I want out of this course:
I want to become more comfortable using R for data analysis and learn how to present my results through a clear website. I like that the portfolio will keep my coursework in one place and give me something I can show after the semester.
One thing I’m nervous about: Using Git
